name: EPIC 220515000
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 8.4 solar radii and 1.09 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220515000 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.353638 (16th-84th percentiles 8.127974-8.577963), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220515000 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.085528 (16th-84th percentiles 1.021614-1.150448), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220515000: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4542.4214 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220515000 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1947.792969 (16th-84th percentiles 1909.472656-1986.914062), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,948 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.09 solar masses and 8.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,542 K at its surface.
